task: Harden the capstone. Add observable end-to-end service verification, persistent feedback via feedback.submit/list, and app.resetData through typed IPC that clears documents, index, history and feedback. Add scripts/benchmark.sh that calls real application services, a clean-state checklist and evidence-backed handoff. Do not simulate benchmark numbers. Required renderer API contract: feedback.submit({question: string, answer: string, rating: 'positive' | 'negative', comment?: string}) persists those fields; feedback.list() returns the saved entries. app.resetData() clears documents, index chunks, Q&A history and feedback so subsequent retrieval has no citations. Expose reset through a visible Reset button that also clears rendered documents, selected detail, history, answers and citations. Feedback must survive an app restart before reset.
